title: Commission & Plant
subtitle: Two-point moisture probe calibration, sealed packet provenance scan, and paired cassette planting

scan_modes.label: Optical Scan Through Intact Seal (Record ALO & N. · 2 Seeds)
Break Seal on Open Bench (Contamination Risk)

alo.title: Cassette A — Alo
alo.role: External Test Specimen (Pressurised Lunar Test Chamber)

EX-CH01-S03.question: PREDICT · Before adjusting a moisture probe with a +10 unit offset, what will it display in a bone-dry (0 moisture) reference cup?

options.label: 0 units (already accurate without calibration)
options.feedback: Not yet: because the probe starts with a +10 offset, it adds 10 units to the true 0 dry cup until we zero it on the dry reference.

options.label: 10 units (+10 offset on a 0 dry reference cup)
options.feedback: Confirmed: the +10 offset shifts dry (0) to 10 and wet (100) to 110. Two-point calibration sets dry to 0 and wet to 100.

options.label: 100 units (saturated wet reference)
options.feedback: 100 units is the calibrated wet reference target. A bone-dry reference cup has 0 moisture, which reads 10 before zeroing.

EX-CH01-S04.question: PREDICT · Why do we plant both Alo (EXTERNAL TEST) and Tara (INDOOR REFERENCE) with 1 seed and 40–60 calibrated moisture (50 nominal)?

options.label: Matched baseline so chamber placement is the only experimental variable
options.feedback: Confirmed: matching seed count (1 each) and calibrated moisture (40–60, 50 nominal) lets Tara serve as a true indoor control for Alo.

options.label: Flooding above 60 units makes seeds germinate twice as fast
options.feedback: Flooding (> 60 units) deprives roots of oxygen inside a sealed cassette. If flooded, drain excess water to waste rather than sealing.

options.label: Give both cassettes the same EXTERNAL TEST label
options.feedback: Each cassette needs a distinct label: EXTERNAL TEST for Alo and INDOOR REFERENCE for Tara so crew logs never confuse the two specimens.

hints.title: Hint 1 — Instrument First
hints.text: Check the instrument before trusting it.

hints.title: Hint 3 — Calibration & Moisture Band
hints.text: Dry must read 0, wet 100, then fill both to 50.

calibrate_probe.title: Step 1 of 4 (Calibration Bench) · Zero the Dry Reference
calibrate_probe.label: Calibrate dry and wet references
calibrate_probe.instruction: Select the Dry Reference Cup (currently reading 10 due to the +10 offset) and set the Zero Offset to -10 so dry reads 0.
calibrate_probe.predict: An uncalibrated probe with a +10 offset reads 10 in a bone-dry cup and 110 in a saturated cup.
calibrate_probe.test: Place the probe in the Dry Reference Cup and adjust Zero Offset from 0 to -10.
calibrate_probe.observe: Dry Reference Cup reading drops from 10 to 0 displayed units.
calibrate_probe.explain: Zeroing removes the constant +10 additive offset at the lower bound of the moisture scale.

span_probe.title: Step 2 of 4 (Calibration Bench) · Set Wet Reference Span
span_probe.label: Set wet reference span
span_probe.instruction: Select the Wet Reference Cup (raw reading 110) and set the Wet Span target to 100 so full saturation reads 100.
span_probe.predict: Without span calibration, the upper reference reads 110 instead of 100.
span_probe.test: Place the zeroed probe in the Wet Reference Cup and set Wet Span to 100.
span_probe.observe: Wet Reference Cup reading settles at 100 displayed units.
span_probe.explain: Span calibration anchors the 100-unit upper bound so every intermediate moisture reading (40–60) is linear and accurate.

recheck_probe.title: Step 3 of 4 (Calibration Bench) · Two-Point Recheck
recheck_probe.label: Recheck dry zero and wet span
recheck_probe.instruction: Verify both reference cups in sequence: confirm Dry Reference = 0 and Wet Reference = 100.
recheck_probe.predict: After adjusting zero and span, re-dipping both cups verifies that neither adjustment drifted.
recheck_probe.test: Check the Dry Reference Cup (0) and Check the Wet Reference Cup (100).
recheck_probe.observe: Dry cup holds steady at 0; Wet cup holds steady at 100. Calibration lock is green.
recheck_probe.explain: A two-point recheck confirms instrument repeatability before measuring live growth media.

inspect_packet.title: Step 4 of 4 (Calibration Bench) · Scan Sealed Seed Packet
inspect_packet.label: Inspect sealed packet and record
inspect_packet.instruction: Run the Optical Scan through the intact packet seal to log the Latin inscription ALO, initial N., and 2 seeds without opening the packet.
inspect_packet.predict: Opening the packet on the commons bench risks moisture and dust exposure before we reach the garden glove port.
inspect_packet.test: Select Optical Scan Through Intact Seal.
inspect_packet.observe: Scanner logs provenance: Inscription 'ALO', Initial 'N.' (Latin letters), Quantity: 2 viable seeds, Seal: INTACT.
inspect_packet.explain: Non-destructive optical logging preserves sterile containment until each seed is transferred into its cassette.

plant_alo.title: Step 1 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Plant Seed in Alo Cassette
plant_alo.label: Plant one seed in the sealed Alo cassette
plant_alo.instruction: Select Cassette A (Alo) and place exactly 1 seed from the scanned packet into its wicking pillow.
plant_alo.predict: Placing 1 seed in Alo leaves 1 matched seed from the same packet for the indoor reference cassette Tara.
plant_alo.test: Set Alo Cassette Seed Count to 1 Seed.
plant_alo.observe: 1 seed is seated in Cassette A (Alo)'s wicking slot; 1 seed remains in the packet for Tara.
plant_alo.explain: Single-seed placement prevents root competition inside the compact lunar cassette.

plant_tara.title: Step 2 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Plant Seed in Tara Cassette
plant_tara.label: Plant one seed in the sealed Tara cassette
plant_tara.instruction: Select Cassette B (Tara) and place the remaining 1 seed into the indoor reference cassette.
plant_tara.predict: With 1 seed in Alo and 1 seed in Tara, both chambers start with identical genetic stock.
plant_tara.test: Set Tara Cassette Seed Count to 1 Seed.
plant_tara.observe: Cassette B (Tara) holds 1 seed; both cassettes are now seeded (1 + 1).
plant_tara.explain: Paired experiments require a matched control specimen from the same seed lot.

water_alo.title: Step 3 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Set Alo Moisture (40–60 Band)
water_alo.label: Set Alo moisture to the calibrated band
water_alo.instruction: Adjust Cassette A (Alo) water level into the calibrated 40–60 band (50 nominal). If flooded above 60, drain excess water to waste.
water_alo.predict: Below 40 is too dry to trigger imbibition; above 60 floods the wicking pillow and must be drained to waste.
water_alo.test: Adjust Alo moisture to 40–60 units (50 nominal) using the calibrated probe.
water_alo.observe: Calibrated probe reads within 40–60 units in Cassette A (Alo) with aerobic pore space intact.
water_alo.explain: In reduced gravity (0.166 g), capillary water bridges pores easily; 40–60 units balances water film and root oxygen.

water_tara.title: Step 4 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Set Tara Moisture (40–60 Band)
water_tara.label: Set Tara moisture to the calibrated band
water_tara.instruction: Adjust Cassette B (Tara) water level into the calibrated 40–60 band (50 nominal). If flooded above 60, drain excess water to waste.
water_tara.predict: Matching Tara's moisture band (40–60, 50 nominal) to Alo's ensures hydration is not a confounding variable.
water_tara.test: Adjust Tara moisture to 40–60 units (50 nominal) using the calibrated probe.
water_tara.observe: Calibrated probe reads within 40–60 units in Cassette B (Tara).
water_tara.explain: Controlled starting moisture across both cassettes isolates environmental stress during the 14-day lunar night.

label_alo.title: Step 5 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Label Alo EXTERNAL TEST
label_alo.label: Label Alo EXTERNAL TEST
label_alo.instruction: Assign the distinct label EXTERNAL TEST to Cassette A (Alo).
label_alo.predict: Clear, non-duplicated labels prevent telemetry or crew observations from swapping test and control.
label_alo.test: Select label EXTERNAL TEST for Cassette A (Alo).
label_alo.observe: Cassette A (Alo) tag is locked as EXTERNAL TEST.
label_alo.explain: Alo is housed in the external-facing lunar test chamber and must be tracked separately from the indoor reference.

label_tara.title: Step 6 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Label Tara INDOOR REFERENCE
label_tara.label: Label Tara INDOOR REFERENCE
label_tara.instruction: Assign the distinct label INDOOR REFERENCE to Cassette B (Tara).
label_tara.predict: Because Alo already holds EXTERNAL TEST, Tara must take the complementary INDOOR REFERENCE label.
label_tara.test: Select label INDOOR REFERENCE for Cassette B (Tara).
label_tara.observe: Cassette B (Tara) tag is locked as INDOOR REFERENCE.
label_tara.explain: Distinct test and reference labels guarantee unambiguous paired records across shifts.

seal_alo.title: Step 7 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Seal Alo Cassette
seal_alo.label: Close Alo cassette seal
seal_alo.instruction: Verify Alo is calibrated, seeded (1), watered (40–60), and labelled (EXTERNAL TEST), then close the cassette seal.
seal_alo.predict: Closing the seal locks Cassette A's internal atmosphere and moisture loop for the chamber run.
seal_alo.test: Switch Cassette A (Alo) Seal to CLOSED & LOCKED.
seal_alo.observe: Alo cassette seal clicks shut and passes pressure check.
seal_alo.explain: The cassette must be sealed only after calibration, 1 seed, 40–60 moisture, and distinct labelling are verified.

seal_tara.title: Step 8 of 8 (Garden Bench) · Seal Tara Cassette
seal_tara.label: Close Tara cassette seal
seal_tara.instruction: Verify Tara is calibrated, seeded (1), watered (40–60), and labelled (INDOOR REFERENCE), then close the cassette seal.
seal_tara.predict: With both Alo and Tara sealed under matched conditions, P-01 Commissioning & Planting is complete.
seal_tara.test: Switch Cassette B (Tara) Seal to CLOSED & LOCKED.
seal_tara.observe: Tara cassette seal clicks shut. Both cassettes are commissioned and ready for paired telemetry.
seal_tara.explain: Sealing both cassettes completes the paired biological setup before the 14-day lunar night.
